note: One flow, kept in ovo-runner/runner.py. The Coordinating Agent runs that flow. This file is the map of which agent runs each stage, not the flow itself. There is no Accuracy stage: accuracy travels inside the enrichment diff.

workers.name: Audit
workers.scope: Audit agent does audit work. Coordinating Agent spawns Audit agent and passes store address.

workers.name: Enrichment
workers.scope: Enrichment agent does enrichment work. Coordinating Agent spawns Enrichment agent and passes the store address. Accuracy travels inside the diff.

workers.name: Merchant Approval
workers.scope: Merchant Approval agent records merchant decisions. Coordinating Agent spawns Merchant Approval agent, passes Enrichment output, and pauses until a decision is recorded.

workers.name: Plugin
workers.output: plugin_run.json, dry-run only until Plugin stream proves token auth on WordPress
workers.scope: Plugin agent does publish work. Coordinating Agent spawns Plugin agent only after approval, and only with approved list. Live post is refused by Plugin runner today.
